acceptance.duplicate_gate: Versioned domain-tagged semantic-core key derived before writes; best-effort repository search for the proposed key and exact public Slack search for the proposed v47 token must return zero matches. Duplicate means no event, no CURRENT update, and no Slack.
acceptance.pointer_gate: Commit and read back this immutable event; fetch CURRENT again; update only if version=46, projection digest=d722951ec9cb1d0430d62b1fd32bf1dac6ebdca3e04e88ed6a45d3f76e22c882, and blob=a4fba43126994dfe579912a675527b5f13de5005; then read back CURRENT, this event, and predecessor.
acceptance.projection_digest_rule: For v47, sha256(canonical_json_utf8(canonical_projection)); stored explicitly and recomputed after readback.
acceptance.slack_rule: After final v47 Git readback only, emit at most one sanitized version-advance pointer. Do not rewrite CURRENT merely to embed the Slack link.
acceptance.stale_rule: Any wake not observing exact v46, prior event digest 88af3e5d..., projection digest d722951e..., and blob a4fba431... must not advance.

experiment.controlled_factor: Keep event canonicalization, v3 semantic-core idempotency, event-first write/readback, exact second CURRENT read, and single-file blob-SHA guard fixed; vary only real provider carrier metadata observed across two consecutive native inventory snapshots while holding task ID, title, schedule, timezone, enabled state, and normalized instruction body fixed.
experiment.hypothesis: Real provider last-run and updated timestamps can drift while the normalized task body and task ID remain stable; whole carrier-envelope digests should differ, but a body-identity digest that excludes volatile provider metadata should remain stable.

experiment.strongest_falsifier: The proposed idempotency key or v47 Slack token already exists; task ID, schedule, enabled state, or normalized instruction-body digest differs; provider metadata does not differ; whole envelope digests unexpectedly match; CURRENT is not exact v46 on the second read; event digest recomputation fails; final CURRENT/event/predecessor bindings disagree; or Slack is posted before final Git readback.

canonical_transition.honest_flaw: The two carrier envelopes are reconstructed from model-visible native task inventory snapshots and a prior immutable event, not provider-signed raw transport captures. Both observations are from one provider and may share one upstream task record. Stable normalized body identity does not prove hidden-envelope integrity, model-version equivalence, replay determinism, cross-account portability, or independent carrier agreement. Git event creation, CURRENT replacement, validation reads, duplicate searches, and Slack posting remain separate effects. Git provides no cross-file atomicity, database isolation, linearizability, exactly-once execution, referential integrity, server-side idempotency uniqueness, Slack atomicity, lock fairness, or automatic orphan repair.
canonical_transition.rollback: Append a compensating event from the then-current version; never delete this event or Slack pointer; replace CURRENT only with its exact then-current blob SHA.
